headline: Anthropic's Claude now handles 95% of internal analytics queries, while NVIDIA achieves a breakthrough in cooling AI machines
tldr: Today's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI capabilities and infrastructure. Anthropic's Claude is now handling a large majority of internal analytics queries, demonstrating its growing utility. Meanwhile, NVIDIA has made a breakthrough in cooling technology for AI servers, allowing for more efficient operation. Additionally, there are concerns over the Trump administration's crackdown on Anthropic and its potential impact on the AI ecosystem. Other stories cover new applications of AI, such as art generation and tool calling, as well as important research on ML model poisoning and neural networks.

new_models.title: Claude’s Hidden Art Skill: Making Illustrations With Code
new_models.summary: Claude can generate art using code, creating illustrations with shapes and coordinates that stay sharp at any size.
